title: 嵌入式即時作業系統
summary: 以即時排程、同步與可界定延遲連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect real-time scheduling, synchronization and bounded latency through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 時間契約與任務
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「時間契約與任務」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop timing contracts and tasks through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: Deadline 契約：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Deadline 契約」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for deadline contracts.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Deadline 契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「為假想控制迴路標示到期點。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for deadline contracts. Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 為假想控制迴路標示到期點。
steps.observationEn: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：優先權繼承能消除所有阻塞時間。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Priority inheritance removes every blocking interval. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Deadline 契約」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit deadline contracts two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: Deadline 契約的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。
knowledge.textEn: Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals.

knowledge.title: Deadline 契約的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 為假想控制迴路標示到期點。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設單核心週期任務 C/T 分別 1/5 ms、2/10 ms、2/20 ms，U=0.5。三任務 RM 充分界=3(2^(1/3)−1)≈0.7798，因此在獨立、可搶佔、deadline=period 等前提可通過此充分測試；不是 Zephyr 保證。
knowledge.textEn: For one core with periodic C/T=1/5, 2/10 and 2/20 ms, U=0.5. The three-task RM sufficient bound is 0.7798, under independent, preemptible tasks with deadlines equal to periods; not a Zephyr guarantee.

quiz.question: 本步審查「Deadline 契約」與整體「嵌入式即時作業系統」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing deadline contracts within embedded real-time operating systems, which statement or check is supported?
options: 硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。
優先權繼承能消除所有阻塞時間。
平均延遲合格即證明硬即時合格。
optionsEn: Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals.
Priority inheritance removes every blocking interval.
Passing mean latency proves hard real-time compliance.
quiz.explanation: 硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。 為假想控制迴路標示到期點。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals. Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: Deadline 契約：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「為假想控制迴路標示到期點。」檢查「Deadline 契約」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for deadline contracts using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「Deadline 契約」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：為假想控制迴路標示到期點。 核對「硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for deadline contracts and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop. Check the principle: Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 為假想控制迴路標示到期點。
steps.observationEn: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：優先權繼承能消除所有阻塞時間。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Priority inheritance removes every blocking interval. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Deadline 契約」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「為假想控制迴路標示到期點。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。

steps.title: 環形緩衝：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「檢查繞回與空滿辨識。」檢查「環形緩衝」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for ring buffers using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「環形緩衝」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：檢查繞回與空滿辨識。 核對「讀寫索引需要一致的擁有權。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for ring buffers and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check wraparound and empty/full distinction. Check the principle: Read/write indices need consistent ownership. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 檢查繞回與空滿辨識。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：平均延遲合格即證明硬即時合格。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Passing mean latency proves hard real-time compliance. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「環形緩衝」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查繞回與空滿辨識。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit ring buffers input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.text: 假設單核心週期任務 C/T 分別 1/5 ms、2/10 ms、2/20 ms，U=0.5。三任務 RM 充分界=3(2^(1/3)−1)≈0.7798，因此在獨立、可搶佔、deadline=period 等前提可通過此充分測試；不是 Zephyr 保證。
knowledge.textEn: For one core with periodic C/T=1/5, 2/10 and 2/20 ms, U=0.5. The three-task RM sufficient bound is 0.7798, under independent, preemptible tasks with deadlines equal to periods; not a Zephyr guarantee.
